author: bardic-inspiration
name: Pinch of Stillness
summary: A pinch of powder that holds a creature in place for a breath.
description: Gathered from the dust beneath a clock that stopped. It is very fine and settles in no wind.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can blow this powder at a creature within 10 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the {ref:condition/paralyzed} condition until the end of its next turn. The powder is consumed.
